verdict.rationale: NVIDIA serves a live root llms.txt at docs.nvidia.com (HTTP 200), described as a collection of llms.txt files for AI user agents. Related stacks such as CUDA, where the file references Blackwell kernel tuning, NIM and NeMo also publish llms.txt files. However, there is no evidence of a DGX B300-specific llms.txt, and the B300 user guide's markdown variant returns 404, so B300 hardware docs are not shown to be agent-ready. Missing for 10: a B300/DGX user-guide llms.txt or markdown docs, confirmation the root index covers DGX B300 documentation, and hands-on corroboration of agent use.
